purpose: Teach: 吹か/絵柄/被る/亡き/女将/桶/安物/小豆

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「秋風を吹かれた公園で散歩しよう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying, 'Let's take a walk in the park while the autumn breeze is blowing.'
lines.style: Soft aunt-voice, gentle and unhurried, the quote delivered with a fond little smile toward the boy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと絵柄の凝った絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei! Me and Dad looked at a picture book with really, really fancy pictures!
lines.style: Bursting, breathless child energy, words tumbling fast, big proud emphasis on 'really, really fancy.'

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「災難を被る前に気付ける目を持って」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: And your dad said, 'Keep your eyes open so you notice trouble before it lands on you.'
lines.style: Slightly slower, leaning in to pass along the advice, tender and a touch conspiratorial, like sharing a secret.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと亡き伯父の墓参り行ったよ
lines.en: Mei, me and Dad went to visit my uncle's grave — the uncle who died.
lines.style: Quieter and more careful than his other lines, simple child solemnity, slowing on the last words.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「老舗の女将さんは粋」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: You know, your dad was saying the okami of an old inn has real style.
lines.style: Brightening the mood again, light admiring lilt on 'real style,' airy and conversational.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと桶ですいかを冷やしたよ
lines.en: Mei! Me and Dad cooled a watermelon in a bucket!
lines.style: Full excitement restored, almost shouting the watermelon news, bouncing rhythm, huge grin in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「安物にも工夫の余地がある」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Your dad also said, 'Even cheap things leave room for a little ingenuity.'
lines.style: Amused, savoring the saying, slight thoughtful pause before 'ingenuity,' warm approval at the close.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと小豆あんを作ったよ
lines.en: Mei, me and Dad made adzuki bean paste all by ourselves!
lines.style: Triumphant closing announcement, chest puffed out, proud stress on 'all by ourselves,' beaming.
